jobs.title: Information Technology Technician
jobs.summary: Installs, maintains and troubleshoots hardware, software and user systems for the Malawi Legal Aid Bureau, providing first-line technical support and ensuring secure, reliable IT operations at the Blantyre duty station.
responsibilities: Install and configure hardware and software components to ensure usability.
Ensure electrical safety standards are met.
Upgrade the entire system to enable compatible software on all computers.
Install and upgrade anti-virus software to ensure security at the user level.
Perform tests and evaluations of new software and hardware.
Provide support to users and be the first point of contact for error reporting.
Perform any other related duties assigned from time to time by relevant officers.
requirements: Diploma in Information Systems, Computer Science or a relevant related field from a recognised and accredited university.
Bachelor's degree in the above related fields will be an added advantage.
A minimum of 1 year experience in computer networks, systems administration and maintenance.
A+ or Cisco Certified Network Associate accreditation is also an added advantage.
